note: Tag vocabulary for the content library. Four independent axes: a creator is positioned in a persona niche, a video takes a format, it opens with a hook, and it is about a topic. Tag all four. `relatable` is the topic of a video about nothing in particular that any model can be handed with a twist; `unknown` is left alone.

persona.label: Persona / niche
persona.hint: How the creator is positioned. Usually stable per creator, so this drives the Models tab.

tags.label: Faceless
tags.desc: Face never shown — body, hands or POV only. Rarely speaks, so it is set on the creator rather than inferred.

tags.label: Funny / comedy
tags.desc: The funny one — humor is the brand: jokes, bits, chaotic energy; the thirst is secondary to the laugh

tags.label: Latina
tags.desc: Latina identity is part of the positioning, not incidental

tags.label: Toxic girlfriend
tags.desc: Jealous, possessive, drama-led — the inverse of GFE warmth

format.label: Content format
format.hint: What this specific video does. Varies per video.

tags.label: Thirst trap
tags.desc: Body-forward, no dance or dialogue hook

tags.label: Talking head
tags.desc: Straight to camera, dialogue carries it

tags.label: Skit
tags.desc: Scripted bit with characters or a scenario

tags.label: Text overlay
tags.desc: On-screen text is the payload; audio secondary

tags.label: Omegle-style
tags.desc: Random video-chat reactions — Omegle/OmeTV/Monkey-style split screen, meeting strangers on camera

tags.label: German format
tags.desc: The German flash-trend playbook — 57 numbered reel formats in six types (bounce, outfit switch, clip bait, shower, facial acting, skit); see lib/german.ts

tags.label: Rage bait
tags.desc: Engineered to provoke argument in comments

tags.label: Mirror
tags.desc: Filmed in or at a mirror — selfie framing, often with a flirty caption

tags.label: Reveal
tags.desc: Builds to a reveal — outfit, look or transformation lands on the cut

tags.label: Confession
tags.desc: Confession-style talking — admits something to camera, intimate and direct

tags.label: Car confession
tags.desc: A confession or story told to camera from the driver's seat

hook.label: Hook type
hook.hint: How the first ~3 seconds grab attention. The highest-signal field for figuring out why something performed.

tags.label: POV / relatable
tags.desc: Names a scenario the viewer is meant to see themselves in — POV:, me when…, when he…

topic.label: Topic / niche
topic.hint: What the video is ABOUT, as opposed to who is in it (persona) or what it does (format). This is what routes a golf reel to a golf model. Most reels have one; `relatable` and `unknown` are the two that are not subjects at all.

tags.label: Golf
tags.desc: On a course, range or simulator; putting, swinging, golf clothes

tags.label: Cars
tags.desc: Driving, car interiors as the subject, builds, racing, car culture

tags.label: Gaming & anime
tags.desc: Games, streaming, anime, cosplay as subject matter

tags.label: Travel
tags.desc: Trips, airports, hotels, being somewhere as the point

tags.label: Pets & animals
tags.desc: Dogs, cats, horses, animals as the subject

tags.label: Motherhood
tags.desc: Kids, pregnancy as life rather than body, mom life

tags.label: Outdoors
tags.desc: Fishing, hunting, camping, hiking, the lake

tags.label: Sports fan
tags.desc: Game day, teams, jerseys, watching sport

tags.label: Work & money
tags.desc: Jobs, bosses, shifts, side hustles, money talk

tags.label: Dating & relationships
tags.desc: Dating life, exes, talking stages, relationship takes

tags.label: Relatable (twistable)
tags.desc: About nothing in particular — a joke, a mood, a moment anyone recognises. Can be handed to any model by keeping the structure and changing the subject to her world.

tags.label: Unknown
tags.desc: Nothing said it. Left alone rather than guessed, and never matched on.
